sentences.text:
This is the second application filed by applicant under Section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.76/2023, registered at Police Station-Garhakota, District Sagar (MP) for the offence punishable under Section 363, 366, 376(3), 376(2)(n), 376(2)(k) of IPC &
Section 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.
Earlier bail application was dismissed for want of prosecution.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is young boy of 20 years and prosecutrix is about 16 years of age.
Applicant is having love affair with prosecutrix.

Later on,
applicant has falsely been implicated in the case of rape.
It is submitted that prosecutrix is consenting party.
In these circumstances, it is prayed that applicant may be released on bail.
3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the bail application.

It is Ajay vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/53753246/
1 submitted that prosecutrix is minor and is aged about 15 years and six months.

entities.text: Ajay vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Allegation of rape has been made against applicant in the statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C, therefore,
applicant may not be released on bail.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5.
Applicant is young boy of 20 years.
Investigation is complete and applicant is no longer required for custodial interrogation.
Prosecutrix is aged about 16 years.
From her statement, it appears that she was consenting party.
6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court.

7. In addition to aforesaid condition, the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
Certified copy as per rules.
